parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource.

The ID of the destination resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   filesystem
*   accesspoint

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the reserved instance. The array may contain up to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tags, each tag key is unique.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of a tag.

Limits:

*   The tag key cannot be null or an empty string.
*   The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.
*   The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.
*   The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of a tag.

Limits:

*   The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.
*   The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
